changes.change: DA001/DA004/DA008 replaced by DR/DC rules and the general data-gap policy after the 2026-10-08 Data agent split.
Authors, year, journal, DOI and study design added; checked online 2026-10-08.
Index ranking requires regimens that separate candidate indices; otherwise ranking stays unresolved. No numeric count.
Infection-model description for in vivo response data.
Separate PK data must match the PD experiment animal state; mismatch recorded as an applicability question.
Dose basis and analyte composition must correspond; conversion factors need a cited source.
